_comment: SPARK — S175 P7: NAMED, DATED WAIVERS FOR THE CROSS-ROW SIZE CHECK.
⛔ WHY THIS FILE EXISTS, AND IT IS NOT TO SILENCE THE GUARD. `atlas-guard` had been RED on every
master run since S171. The owner named the real cost himself: a permanently red job is where a
REAL failure hides, because nobody reads it any more. P7 fixed the nine FRINGE sheets outright.
These five are the other class and they cannot be fixed in code.
⭐ THE MEASUREMENT THAT MAKES THIS A WAIVER AND NOT A SHRUG. These rows disagree about the
character's WIDTH, not its height (every height ratio measures 0.96-1.03). That is a POSE
difference — a beetle standing with its legs together is narrower than the same beetle mid-stride
— not a zoom error. S173 BUILT the horizontal squash the owner asked for (`normaliseStateWidth`),
measured it on the scarab, and it made the spread WORSE: 1.42x -> 1.71x. It was reverted and the
flag was kept precisely because the measurement is the evidence.
⇒ The only real fix is REGENERATED ART, which is the owner's call and his generation budget.
Until then these five are known, named and dated here, and every OTHER sheet still fails the
check normally. A new size mismatch anywhere else turns the job red again — which is the whole
⚠ TO RETIRE AN ENTRY: regenerate the clip with visible empty margin, rebuild, and DELETE the line.
reason: cross-row WIDTH disagreement = pose, not zoom. normaliseStateWidth measured WORSE (1.42x -> 1.71x, S173). Needs regenerated art.
